title: WakeCore ingress event (CloudEvents 1.0 structured JSON, RFC §6)
description: Body of POST /v1/ingress/{source_ref}, authenticated by X-WakeCore-Signature (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body with the binding's ingress secret). source must equal the binding's source_uri; types starting with 'wakecore.' are reserved. Unsupported data.schema_version is quarantined, not rejected. Mirrors wakecore/kernel/events/admission.py.
